body.statement: On the arm-tape experiment, \(P(M_{a,\Delta}+U_{a,\Delta})=P[Y(a)\mathbf 1\{D(a)\leq h_{T,\Delta}\}]\), \(|b_{T,\Delta}|\leq B_{T,\Delta}=2L(1+T+\Delta_T)^{-\beta}(1+o(1))\), and \(\operatorname{Var}_P(U_{1,\Delta}-U_{0,\Delta})\leq v_{T,\Delta}(J_1^{-1}+J_0^{-1})=O(T^{-\rho\beta-\rho(1-\alpha)})=o(T^{-(1-\alpha)})\), uniformly over \(\mathfrak M_T(\alpha,\beta,L,c,C,\varepsilon)\cup\mathfrak M_T^{\mathrm{low}}(\alpha,\beta,L,c,\varepsilon)\) and deterministic \(\Delta_T\geq0\).
body.justification: The shifted old cohort uses every response observable by the prespecified terminal time and leaves only the \(T+\Delta_T\) tail while contributing negligible noise at the rare-arm sampling scale.
body.gap: Single-age delayed estimators leave bias of order \(m_T^{-\beta}\); no located inference result uses an overlapping old prefix to recover the newly revealed tail under informative delays.
body.consumer: This correction allows end-of-recruitment inference to use nearly all available follow-up without sacrificing the Gaussian sampling rate.
